cleaner.line: Sweet Loretta Fart she thought she was a cleaner
stanza: Sweet Loretta Fart she thought she was a cleaner
But she was a frying pan
The picker, the picker, picture the fingers burning

greener.line: I could tell you that the grass is really greener
stanza: I've always lived in a mansion
On the other side of the moon
And I never sing out of tune
I could tell you that the grass is really greener
On the other side of the hill
But I can't communicate with you
And I guess I never will
